title: nelsonia nummulariifolia
intro: Nelsonia nummulariifolia, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennywort include its ability to act as an adaptogen, supporting the body's natural response to stress, as well as its potential to aid in wound healing and improve cognitive function. The bioactive constituents of Indian pennywort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
